name: War Thunder original oak medium A LOD0, shared64 source copies

cluster.base_anchor_note: Explicit original WT object pivot [0,0,0], transformed with the source normalization. Retains original buried root geometry rather than planting its lowest root at the surface.

physical_size_note: Original412-triangle WT oak medium A LOD0. Both budget thresholds exceed its actual source count: no simplification and no whole-tree impostor. Source scale and original ground pivot retained. DAE OBJ rounds coordinates to four decimals and recomputes normals. Original diffuse RGB/dedicated alpha; roughness0.9 approximation. Packed normals/PBR, wind and subsurface are not reconstructed. Runtime retains highest geometry regardless of distance.
